suitelet.description: Returns a sales order's pro forma invoice PDF (custtmpl_cen_jlo_so_proforma) for ?soid=<internal id>. Opened by the Print Pro Forma button.
suitelet.name: JLo - Print Pro Forma Invoice

scriptcustomfield.description: Full URL of the logo printed on the pro forma invoice. A company preference, set once per account (Setup > Company > General Preferences > Custom Preferences), because the file URL differs between sandbox and production. Blank prints no logo.
scriptcustomfield.help: Full URL of the logo image for the pro forma invoice header, from the image file's URL in the File Cabinet (the file must be Available Without Login).
scriptcustomfield.label: Pro Forma Logo URL
